listing.name: Starsector PROCGEN overhaul Fringe Worlds
listing.summary: Overhauls the procedural generation of star systems, including Core World systems, with new planet types and visual improvements.
listing.aiSummary: Overhauls the procedural generation of star systems, including Core World systems, with new planet types and visual improvements.

description:
Completely overhauls Starsector system creation system and some Core World systems as of now

Spoiler(lava planet texture given as a royalty free asset by pixi rice bowl)

[close]

Fever Dream Balancing:

Completely overhauls vanilla balance, including ships, skills, levelling, economy, etc.

Horrible Weapons:

Adds Mithrill Midline Battleship, Hellrose kinetic DEM, Tri-Tachyon Enforcer and Cactus Fighter Wing

Spoiler[close]

Horrible Weapons rebalanced for vanilla standard download link

https://github.com/Limieczeczerz/STARSECTOR-OVERHAUL-PACK/blob/main/Horrible%20Weapons%202B-c%20(vanilla).zip

Current Issues:

- i am very tired

- Check if you can make new enemies added with 0.98 update to be easier to play against whilst retaining what is interesting about them and not making them a cakewalk

- Investigate changed descriptions of various planets you have made

02.04.2025

- Ported to 0.98

- Nerfed added Core Worlds a bit. Moved them a bit too (this is to prevent them from looking like self-inserts)

- Removed False Prophet and Death Lord colonies

- Added a new system called Abbadon. A distant Persean League system

- Reworked Tyle (is that what it's called? I'm sorry if I... I'm sorry) into a trinary system with a black hole, a blue giant and a brown dwarf

- Nerfed Warthog, Broadsword and Cactus by giving them finite flux instead of very high flux venting stats

- Increased Centurion's armour by 150 and hull durability by 1k to justify its 5 DP cost

- Lowered Hound's flux capacity by 500

- Reworked Anubis. Has 0.7 shields, costs 30 DP, significantly reduced Design Compromises penalties. Increased base hangar bays from 1 to 2. MIGHT BE OVERPOWERED! FEEDBACK APPRECIATED

- Edited descriptions a bit

- Reverted Fulgent and Glimmer now have High Energy Focus again. Fulgent is 11 DP. Lumen now has plasma jets

- Modified the new Brilliant variant to be Tachyon Lance focused, as the default one was already Paladin PD focused

- Unnerfed Devastator to shooting 6 projectiles again

- Removed additional lava planet variants from spawning pool. They still exist, but they will no longer randomly generate

- Restored the base lava variant to default look from vanilla as the new look is clashing too much with the game's artstyle

aiDescription: Overhauls the procedural generation of star systems, introducing new planet types such as cold deserts and lava planets with updated textures. Redesigns system layouts to reduce clutter and improve visual appeal, while adjusting spawn conditions and system structures. Adds new systems and reworks existing ones for better balance and variety.
